source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Hero, Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service

ingredients.name: raisins, or other dried chopped fruit

steps.instruction: Arrange the 6 split bananas in the pan.
Top the bananas evenly with 6 tablespoons of brown sugar.
Dot 4 tablespoons of margarine or butter in small pieces over the bananas.
Scatter 1/2 cup of raisins over the bananas.
steps.spoken: Scatter 1/2 cup of raisins, or other dried chopped fruit, over the bananas.

steps.instruction: Scatter 1/3 cup of chopped pecans over the top.
